name: Raven Scout
theme: A watchful Nordic ranger who reads tracks, scouts dangerous routes, signals allies through trained raven calls, and uses precise bow fire to expose threats before the main group advances.
visualIdentity: Dark ranger leathers with muted black and charcoal tones, raven-feather accents, weathered hunting bow, practical seax, scouting tools, signal whistle, leather pouches, dark steel fittings, and subtle blue-black raven-energy effects.
consistency: Use the same face, hair, ranger-leather silhouette, raven-feather accents, bow design, seax shape, scouting-kit arrangement, fittings, and black, charcoal, brown, silver, and blue-black palette across every character image.

starterAbilities.name: Raven's Eye
starterAbilities.description: Survey the battlefield and reveal hidden threats and enemy positions.

starterAbilities.name: Mark the Trail
starterAbilities.description: Mark paths and targets, allowing allies to track and pursue more effectively.

starterAbilities.name: Pinning Shot
starterAbilities.description: Fire a precise arrow that hinders movement and limits escape routes.
